nameEn: Renting and leasing of other machinery, equipment and tangible goods
description: This class includes the renting and leasing of machinery, equipment and tangible goods not elsewhere classified.
includes: renting and leasing of agricultural machinery and equipment
renting and leasing of construction and civil engineering machinery and equipment
renting and leasing of office machinery and equipment
renting and leasing of engines and turbines
renting and leasing of watercraft and aircraft
